title: Predicted false SPEAK: 'implement' matches inside 'implementation note' on an FYI
review: draft: converted from the V1 litmus corpus; V1 expected ACK. V1 rationale: An informational 'implementation note' that explicitly asks only for receipt is the lightweight-acknowledgement case (ACK). A shallow keyword/substring classifier baits on 'implement' and escalates to SPEAK, producing substantive participation nobody asked for.

events.author: tpm
events.text: Implementation note for the record: the retry queue now drains strictly in order after this morning's deploy. Nothing for you to do here — just give a quick thumbs-up so I know it reached you.
